propositions: Inbound parent-clear mutations are never emitted when a Jira parent is removed because the snapshot omits absent parents and the differ refuses parent_id=None without positive peer evidence
A local parent that rebar never pushed to the peer is cleared on observing no peer parent, destroying local parent edges without proof the peer ever had that state

The apply layer is ready to consume parent_id=None clears but the detection layers collapse two distinct states (queried-absent vs unresolvable) into one, making safe emission impossible without an evidence gate
Positive evidence that the peer once carried a parent must arbitrate the clear decision via per-binding peer-state tracking to prevent silent data loss from fail-open degradation

The same-pass suppression of inbound clears when outbound writes the same field cannot fire for parent because the emit gate is disjoint from the clear gate, leaving a residual window that is the normal case
